cause: A live metabolomics review identified a probe whose unchanged mutation and rationale satisfy the public tolerance but whose kind was wrong_solution. The repair schema could correct check IDs and rationale but could not express the reviewed classification correction. The running campaign remains frozen.
change: The existing GLM quality-repair stage may explicitly correct a probe kind with a public-rule justification. Null preserves the original kind. No new stage, tool, model-call allowance or scientific operator edit is introduced.
guards: Original mutation programs, names, focus and source evidence are immutable.
Every scientific check must retain wrong-result coverage; a classification correction cannot remove its only negative control.
At least one valid alternative remains required.
Fresh execution and independent final review still gate acceptance; a grader reward alone is not a justification.
Original probes, corrected probes and explicit before/after classifications are preserved in release evidence.
No grading threshold or scientific target was changed to force the current candidate to pass.
code_quality: Ruff lint/format, ty and diff whitespace checks passed. Experimental Python files were checked explicitly.
initial_selection_error: An initial test command named a nonexistent test_grading_protocol.py. No tests ran; the corrected actual-file selection produced the results above.
